scope: Ordinary played minion and hero current target eligibility

state_logic.invalid: return false, UpdateActorState continues to ordinary non-hand hover state2 or idle1; no orange eligibility
state_logic.exit_targeting: Return to normal DoOptionHighlight response mode, restoring ready6/hover7 or idle1 as appropriate
state_logic.selected_attacker: During mode3 not valid target => ordinary hovered2 or idle1. Do NOT fall through to normal option ready6/7.

state_apply.setup: HighlightState.Setup: one Random.value seed per component, currentState1, renderer disabled
state_apply.change: copy bound state material properties, set preserved _Seed, RenderSilouette, apply bound offset. No PlayMakerFSM on current hero/minion plane, so enable renderer immediately.
state_apply.hide: state0,1 disables renderer immediately; state29 also hides without FSM

silhouette_pipeline.geometry_filter: enabled MeshRenderer with MeshFilter/sharedMesh and nonempty Material.GetTag("Highlight",false). For each submesh min(mesh.subMeshCount,sharedMaterials.count). Hide highlight plane itself during render.
silhouette_pipeline.root_setup: save actor world rotation+localScale, set root world scale1 and identity world rotation, then restore after rendering
silhouette_pipeline.resolution: derive HighlightRender plane renderer world bounds: X=size.x, H=max(size.z,size.y); larger dimension256, other=int(256*smaller/larger); baseOrtho=H*0.5
silhouette_pipeline.format_note: RenderTextureFormat.R8; source new output via RenderTextureTracker. All pass outputs scalar red replicated RGBA.
silhouette_pipeline.material_override: final scalar silhouette texture replaces highlight material _MainTex; _FlareTex remains original
silhouette_pipeline.source_shaders: highlight_resource_manifest.json + highlight_builtin_resources.json; decoded DXBC directories Custom_Selection_* and Custom_Unlit_Color_*
compatibility_limits: Render projection, render target format, sampling, actor transform snapshot and replacement-material culling must be recreated; copying the source material onto arbitrary oval is not exact.
Legacy static snapshots of actor can only be reused if contributing renderer visibility/geometry matches; source recreates on VisibilityStatesChanged or force.
Do not mark eligible pixels as verified before renderer/RT adapter is exercised.

shader_time.enabled: m_time=float32(m_time+float32(deltaTime/20)); if >65535 subtract65535 once; if resulting<=0 setfloat32 .0001
shader_time.source: shader_time_runtime.cil.json copied from verified v31 source
shader_time.adapter: advance(delta,shared_shader_time=-1) supports existing native_summon_player shared clock; default local accumulation sourceequation

source_asset_loader.verified_coverage: This existing manifest contains plane mesh and all minion/hero state2/6/7/26/27 materials/shaders/textures; no asset merge necessary for material loader. Hero actor root/mesh itself from original_endgame_v33 loader separately.
source_asset_loader.hero_warning: Use source hero mesh/profile to generate silhouette. Legacy board hero image correlation and placement are still explicit projection compatibility; do not raster bitmap alpha or draw an ellipse and call it source mask.

attached_states.source_filter: Entire actor m_RootTransform.GetComponentsInChildren<MeshRenderer>; no layer filter; material Highlight tag nonempty; active hierarchy and renderer enabled
attached_states.adapter: set_actor_state(id,actor,kind,state,attachments=[]), attachments contains status instance dictionaries with renderers; each mesh global transform normalized to same actor root
attached_states.refresh: Current renderers visibility/mesh RID/transforms in cache signature. Source supports continuous force update for animated taunt mesh. CPU draft first-cache ~1.5s not production GPUperformance parity.
